name: Cavenago di Brianza (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cavenago di Brianza (an eagle above a red and white chequy) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI CAVENAGO DI BRIANZA in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Cavenago di Brianza, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cavenago di Brianza arms — eagle above a red and white chequy, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CAVENAGO DI BRIANZA beneath the arms
